_about: Package P17's named characters, as npc.gd properties (moy_pkg_P17.md, section 7). Colours are [r, g, b]. Keys starting with an underscore are the parts the kit does not have yet: they are proposed new shared figure options, drawn in the model, built in round P17c.

Palbert Pinestein._hair: wild: a bald crown with a white storm of tufts round the sides and back, standing out and up (proposed FigureHair.STYLE_WILD)
Palbert Pinestein._coat: lab coat: off-white, knee-length, open at the front, over his shirt, pockets sagging with charged batteries, one glowing azure (proposed wears_lab_coat)

Dr. Vera Kask._pin: one thin vertical azure pin at the collar, the colour and shape of the tower's eye (proposed: a small worn ornament)
